previous_versions.body: Actually, the same question/argument can be asked/made about SHA-224 and SHA3-224. Shall we move them in "disallowed" as well? @unprovable?
Actually, the same argument can be made about SHA-224 and SHA3-224. Shall we move them in "disallowed" as well? @unprovable?

I re-read the [NIST recommendations listed on KeyLength.com](https://www.keylength.com/en/4/) and the three of them (SHA-512/224, SHA-224 and SHA3-224) *are* approved by NIST for use with HMAC, KMAC, KDF and random bit generation.
